notes.title: Update v0.6
notes.content:
[h3]Matchmaking Server[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved server performance and stability.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]

[list]
[*] Rebalanced in game energy income to increase average game time.
[*] Rebalanced base unit costs to reflect these changes.
[*] As a consequence, abilities now add less overall cost to units.
[*] Rebalanced basic unit stats to better serve the new gameplay style.
[*] Added control zone & totems to the middle of the lane which damages the controlling players' enemy base over time.
[*] Added visual feedback to represent taking base damage from either the void or control zone.
[*] Added a 5 second pre-combat phase to give you a moment to prepare for battle.
[*] Can now use keyboard shortcuts for selection units and faction spells.
[*] Numbers 1 to 5 on the keyboard select units.
[*] ‘Q’ and ‘E’ now selection Faction Spell 1 & 2
[/list]

[h3]Gamemodes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 10 different premade bot teams that will be chosen randomly upon joining a bot game.
[*] Added ranked functionality to 1v1 gamemode, where you will now verse players of a similar skill level.
[*] Added challenge feature to challenge your Steam friends.
[/list]

[h3]Camera[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced zoom out capacity.
[*] Can now move the camera horizontally with the mouse cursor or the WASD keys.
[/list]

[h3]Maps[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved performance on all levels.
[*] Newlands lighting update to reduce model washout.
[*] Deadlands directional light rotated to show more obvious shadows.
[*] Deadlands removed fences causing poor shadow quality and replaced them with columns.
[*] Rhinelands lighting update to reduce model washout.
[*] Rhinelands colour spectrum changes to create more variation in foliage and ground.
[*] Rhinelands directional light changed to show more shadows on units.
[*] Rhinelands water shader changed to improve performance.
[*] Fjordlands lighting update to make it less blue and shadows less harsh.
[/list]

[h3]Faction Spells[/h3]
[list]
[*] Skeleton Faction Spell 1 has been changed to spawn a wave of 10 Bone Warriors from the summon zone.
[*] Damage, Health and Move Speed have been reduced on Bone Warriors.
[*] All faction spell icons have been replaced to better represent what they do.
[*] Faction spells now start on cooldown.
[*] Human Faction Spell 2 has been converted to a barrage of large explosive projectiles.
[*] Added new placeholder VFX to faction spells for visual feedback.
[/list]

[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] New game logo has been added to the loading screen when connecting to the game server.
[*] Placeholder names for factions have been replaced to be called Humans & Skeletons.
[*] Unit names have been changed to their respective class names.
[*] Ability icons now load in on unit cards when in-game.
[*] Lighting removed from Main Menu.
[*] New unit art for UI for all default skins.
[*] Faction spell lock out now shows readiness.
[*] Changed placeholder font to suit theme.
[*] Added indicator at the top of the in-game screen to show control zone status.
[/list]

[h3]Abilities[/h3]
[list]
[*] 15 x new abilities for each unit in each faction.
[*] Ability descriptions adjusted to be more clear.
[*] Complete rebalancing of most of the abilities to reflect the new base cost of the factions.
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new placeholder SFX where there was previously no SFX.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Projectiles now appear when Ranged units attack.
[*] AI no longer walks off the map after killing an enemy.
[*] Team saves now work correctly.
[*] Units being sacrificed into the void no longer crit the base.
[/list]

[h3]Known Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Human Ranged Unit death animation will sometimes play twice.
[*] Unit pathing will sometimes cause units to push each other.
[*] When finishing a round, your build will reset the selection back to build #1 in your decks.
[*] Human Ranged Unit will sometimes not target enemy units correctly and miss.
[*] Damage counter will sometimes display the incorrect amount (still works correctly behind the scenes).
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Beta #2 v0.5
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes v0.5[/h1]

[h3]Removed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed all abilities from the previous build.
[*] Disabled Dragons, Orcs, and Animals Factions.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 5 x new abilities to each unit in Human & Skeletons factions.
[*] Increased base cost for Humans and Skeletons.
[*] Decreased the length of the lane to make it shorter.
[/list]
[h3]Camera[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added zooming to the in-game camera.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Exit button is now functional on the main menu.
[*] Added loading screen before going into a battle to load in map.
[*] Swapped placeholder Human melee and ranged unit art to make more sense.
[/list]
[h3]Maps[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lighting update on Newlands level.
[*] Added Deadlands, Rhinelands and Fjordlands maps to map rotation.
[*] Added updated Newlands.
[*] Added random map rotation.
[*] Fixed Deadlands level summon zone left behind after cleanup.
[/list]
[h3]Models & Animations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Replaced all models and animations with our latest versions for testing.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed ranged units using projectiles missing arrows and targeting nothing.
[*] Fixed ranged units targeting the base after killing an enemy.
[*] Improved Unit AI pathing, but still a known issue that units walk off the map at times.
[/list]
[h3]Known Bugs/Things Missing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bots are currently set to be made up of Skeleton Support Units with one ability each.
[*] AI pathing still has units walking off the map at times.
[*] Ability Icons not loading on unit cards when in game.
[*] Death animations are not functioning correctly on some units.
[*] Health bars do not disappear until death animation is complete.
[*] Faction Spells missing markers not displaying any visual effects.
[*] Units spawning with -0 on the health splash numbers.
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41605740/aba3aa927e4bf4ae59dce8a3e03bf5d40f2c3556.png[/img]
